items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Did you play with Bushall a long time or just a few jobs? No, just a few jobs.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know all of them. Thomas bands too. Yeah. They have orchestrations, Thomas?

Well, they wasn't using orchestrations. They wasn't using orchestrations playing by head, but you get a new number. They don't use them until you get it down. Would Buddy use orchestrations at all? No. What about Bushall? Well, Bushall, he was good. He's the only one that I could think of that reminded me of Buddy some things he'd make. Did he have orchestrations in his man? Yeah. Well, they didn't have a word much about it. Yeah. Did you play with Bushall a long time or just a few jobs? No, just a few jobs.

Well, you say you enjoy playing with all bands. Do you enjoy playing with all the different bands around town now that you work with the same? Well, yeah, I enjoy it. You just as soon played with the band at the paddock as with Kid Thomas, say, or Percy? Yeah. You notice any difference between the bands? No.
